We first find the proper divisors of 284.  
The prime factorization of 284 is \(2^2 \times 71\), so its divisors are 1, 2, 4, 71, 142, 284.  
Its proper divisors are 1, 2, 4, 71, 142. Their sum is \(1+2+4+71+142 = 220\).

Next, we find the proper divisors of this sum, 220.  
The factorization of 220 is \(2^2 \times 5 \times 11\). The sum of all divisors of 220 is given by the divisor function \(\sigma(220) = (2^3-1)/(2-1) \times (5^2-1)/(5-1) \times (11^2-1)/(11-1) = 7 \times 6 \times 12 = 504\).  
Subtracting 220 gives the sum of proper divisors: \(504 - 220 = 284\).

Thus, the sum of the proper divisors of the sum of the proper divisors of 284 is 284.

Answer: 284
